Offline embedding refresh jobs are scheduled batch processes that regenerate vector embeddings for a corpus when the underlying embedding model changes or source documents update in bulk.

## Operational Model

These jobs typically operate on a fixed cadence rather than on demand. The workflow:

1. Re-embeds the full or incremental document set using a potentially new model
2. Swaps the new vectors into the retrieval index atomically to avoid serving mixed-model results mid-transition

## Key Operational Concerns

### Model Versioning
- Maintain explicit versioning of the embedding model per batch
- Track which model version produced which set of vectors to enable debugging and rollback

### Vector Drift Monitoring
- Monitor drift between old and new vectors to detect quality regressions
- Compare embedding changes to understand model behavior shifts

### Staged Deployment
- Stage the swap behind a blue/green index pattern
- Allows quality regression detection before cutover
- Enables rollback if issues are discovered after swap
